tasks.title: Check your I-901 SEVIS fee payment record
Report to your school's international student office
Gather residency evidence for California REAL ID
Apply for a California REAL ID card
Ask your DSO to confirm SEVIS registration

rules.statement: Retrieve your latest admission record through CBP's official I-94 service and print it if needed.
rules.evidence: See your most recent I-94 form and print it, in case you need your record of legal admission to the U.S.

rules.statement: Check the official I-901 payment record for the fee that applied to your entry. Continuing-student and transfer exceptions may apply; this task does not create a new payment obligation.
rules.evidence: If the fee is paid on your behalf, a copy of your I-901 fee payment confirmation can be printed

rules.statement: Contact your school's DSO after entering the United States and follow the school's arrival-reporting instructions. School-specific procedures remain unverified.
rules.evidence: Immediately contact your designated school official (DSO) when you enter the United States.

rules.statement: Report to CRC's International Student Advisor as soon as you arrive. Completing check-in does not confirm SEVIS activation.
rules.evidence: It is important to report to the CRC International Student Advisor as soon as you arrive.

rules.statement: For California REAL ID, prepare two different printed residency documents that meet the official checklist's name, address and exception instructions. This count does not apply to Standard ID; the documents need not come from different institutions.
rules.evidence: To prove that you live in California, you must present TWO DIFFERENT printed documents that show your California mailing address.

rules.statement: Follow California DMV's first-time ID application instructions and complete the required office steps. For REAL ID, follow its identity and residency checklist as well.
rules.evidence: Complete a Driver’s License (DL) or ID Card Application

rules.statement: If you choose to open a U.S. bank account, check the bank's accepted identification, address information, fees and opening requirements. Acceptance of applicants without an SSN varies by provider.
rules.evidence: some banks and credit unions accept foreign passports and consular IDs

rules.statement: Official recommendation — DHS driver's-license guidance: ask your DSO to confirm your SEVIS record is Active before applying for a driver's license. This source does not establish a California REAL ID-card prerequisite. Refer individual immigration-status questions to your DSO.
rules.evidence: Confirming with your DSO that your student record is Active

rules.statement: For CRC Fall 2026 students who enroll on or after July 25, 2026, payment is due the next day after enrollment. These students are not dropped for non-payment, but unpaid fees after the term ends result in a hold on future enrollment until payment is received.
rules.evidence: The next day after enrollment date
